decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope and have a 'conservation style' with a central mullion.

Condition : 4 - The installation of two rooflights to the rear roof slope of the existing house, as shown on drawing KGS/GUN/274P1/1, received 22 December 2006, is satisfactory as it is considered that the proposal would be compatible with the scale and form of the original building and would maintain the character of the general street scene and preserves the appearance and character of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Installation of two rooflights to the rear roof slope of the existing house.
